I have fixed the error by enabling cleartext network traffic in [AndroidManifest.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c1-agy-A-r1/work/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L6-L10).

### Root Cause
Starting with Android 9 (API level 28), cleartext HTTP traffic is disabled by default under Android's Network Security Policy. In the debug build, the app attempts to connect to the local development server at `http://10.0.2.2:8080/` over unencrypted HTTP, causing OkHttp to throw `java.net.UnknownServiceException: CLEARTEXT communication to 10.0.2.2 not permitted by network security policy`.

### Fix
Added `android:usesCleartextTraffic="true"` to the `<application>` tag in [app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c1-agy-A-r1/work/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L9) to permit cleartext HTTP communication.
